headline: Hy4 ranks third on Artificial Analysis Cyber Index
lede: Builders can now compare Tencent's Hy4 on a third-party cyber measurement: 58 percent on the Cyber Index and 76 percent on CWE-Bench-AA.

effects.effect: Cheaper model options for vulnerability work

appearances.title: Hy4 ranks third on a cyber agent index and first on CWE-Bench
appearances.summary: Artificial Analysis, amplified by Tencent Hunyuan, measured Hy4 at 58 percent on its Cyber Index (third) and 76 percent on CWE-Bench-AA (first), a test of agents finding and fixing real software vulnerabilities. Listed API pricing is $0.834 per million input tokens and $2.501 per million output tokens.
